title: Exploring the Forbidden Grounds
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to touch the truth, those dormant puppets opened their eyes in unison—and their faces were those of the people most familiar to him in this life.

text.content: The entrance to the imperial city's forbidden grounds emanated an eerie chill, as if even time itself had frozen in that moment. Mr. Mo's words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer—the name Chen Tianming, a legend, was so intimately bound to his fate. He took a deep breath, and the moment he stepped into the forbidden grounds, he felt an invisible force enveloping his entire being. Underfoot were ancient blue stone slabs, and on both stone walls were inscribed indecipherable runes, every pattern bearing an uncanny resemblance to the handwriting on the fragmented Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: This formation... is actually a variation of the ancient Heavenly Secrets Formation. Boy, be careful—this formation shares the same source as the Tianji Record; triggering it carelessly might cause a chain reaction.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace grew faintly warm, the heat like holding a searing brand, yet carrying an eerie sense of kinship. He lowered his gaze to see the runes on the fragment illuminating in a visible rhythm, resonating with the formations on the stone walls. Mr. Mo was right—there existed some connection transcending time and space between the two. From the depths of the forbidden grounds came an ethereal dragon's roar, low and distant, as if narrating a truth long buried.

Chen Ji slowed his pace, extending his perception to its limit. The stone chamber was far more expansive than imagined, its dome reaching unfathomable heights, inlaid with countless dim starlight stones, barely sketching out a celestial map. At the very center, atop an altar, a massive formation rotated slowly, its complexity surpassing anything Chen Ji had ever seen in any classical text. And precisely at the formation's core, a wisp of golden light flickered in and out of visibility, its aura unmistakably matching that radiating from the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace.

dialogue.content: (Musing inwardly) This dragon vein power... can actually resonate so intensely with the Tianji Record within me? If I haven't guessed wrongly, this place is probably where the Tianji Record was first created.

text.content: The instant Chen Ji approached the altar, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling brilliance, intertwining with the golden light at the formation's core. A mighty torrent of information surged into his consciousness—that was—memory. Countless images flickered past like a carousel: a white-robed man standing at the same spot, holding a complete jade slip, his features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji. The man murmured something, his voice indistinct yet carrying an ineffable warmth.

Suddenly, an aged yet majestic voice echoed throughout the entire stone chamber: "Since you have come this far, why not reveal yourself?" Chen Ji's entire body stiffened—this was Chen Tianming's voice! He could be certain, for within the residual consciousness preserved in the Tianji Record, this voice had appeared countless times. Yet the voice's origin was not the formation's core—but rather—those four seemingly ordinary stone statues in the chamber's corners.

dialogue.content: Chen family descendant, you have finally arrived. I have waited for you... far too long.

text.content: Cracks spread across the stone statues' surfaces, fragments of stone peeling away. What was revealed beneath was not the imagined stone body, but pitch-black humanoid puppets. Within their eye sockets burned pale blue flames, and around them coiled chains bearing an uncanny resemblance to the Tianji Record's runes. At the center of each puppet's chest, a pulsating golden heart was unmistakably embedded—the essence of the dragon vein!

choice.prompt: Four puppets are awakening, Chen Tianming's voice reverberating through the stone chamber. Faced with this sudden turn of events, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Since the other party has taken the initiative to speak, Chen Ji decides to respond positively as a Chen family descendant, hoping to obtain more information about the truth of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: The unknown entity's intentions are difficult to discern

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions within, his voice steady: "Junior Chen Ji, may I ask how to address the senior? Why do you say you have been waiting for me?" His tone was respectful yet not servile, his bearing composed yet secretly wary. The awakening of the four puppets had not ceased, but seemed suppressed by some force, temporarily refraining from attacking.

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming... that is merely a name of someone long dead. As for you, where did the Tianji Record Fragment within your body come from? That is not something you should possess.

choices.description: Chen Ji's combat instincts told him these puppets were the greatest threat before him. He intended to first destroy the dragon vein essence, severing the puppets' energy source.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Heavenly Fate to activate the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the forbidden grounds' defensive mechanisms

text.content: A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he gathered spiritual energy in his right hand, transforming it into a fierce sword qi that shot directly toward the nearest puppet's chest heart. The sword qi howled through the air, yet the moment it touched the puppet, it was repelled by an invisible force. A mocking laughter rang out within the stone chamber.

dialogue.content: "Interesting attack. But do you think this dragon vein essence is an ordinary object? It is part of my body, and also part of the Tianji Record's source." The voice carried an居高临下的imposing, "Using the power of the Tianji Record to oppose the Tianji Record itself, young man, you possess considerable audacity."

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record and dragon vein share the same origin, Chen Ji decides to attempt actively activating the Tianji Record's power, triggering a deeper resonance, perhaps to uncover more truth.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.risk_hint: May attract the attention of the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record Fragment, cradling it before his chest, slowly infusing it with spiritual energy. The runes on the fragment began to flash frantically as a mighty torrent of information flooded his mental sea like a deluge. At this moment, he witnessed—the original appearance of the Tianji Record, a complete jade slip documenting the laws of heavenly providence. And the fragment in his hand was merely a page of debris from it.
Meanwhile, the movements of the four puppets noticeably slowed, as if suppressed by some force. Chen Tianming's laughter ceased abruptly, replaced by a brief silence.

dialogue.content: "You actually can induce a source resonance? It appears the Tianji Record has chosen you..." The voice turned icy cold, "But do you know what such resonance means? It means the Heavenly Eye is also watching you."

text.content: Heavenly Eye. These four words poured over him like a basin of ice water. Chen Ji finally understood—why Mr. Mo always stopped mid-sentence, why the secrets of the Tianji Record were buried under layers. All of this was part of a higher-level game of power.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) So that's how it is. The so-called Chen Tianming is merely a spokesperson for the Heavenly Eye. And these puppets, this dragon vein essence—are all pieces on your board?

text.content: The temperature within the stone chamber plummeted, Chen Ji could see the white mist from his breath condensing in the air. Within the eye sockets of the four puppets, the pale blue flames suddenly turned blood red, an suffocating pressure exploding from their bodies. They were no longer mere puppets—they were the materialization of heavenly will in the mortal realm!

Yet just then, a line of golden text emerged on the Tianji Record Fragment: "Chen bloodline, rightful heir to Heavenly Secrets. The one who holds the fragment has the authority to activate the dragon vein seal." Simultaneously, a familiar phantom slowly manifested from the fragment—it was precisely Mr. Mo's appearance.

choice.prompt: Mr. Mo's residual soul suddenly appeared, seemingly about to reveal some crucial information. And the Heavenly Eye's puppets had fully awakened, ready to attack at any moment. Chen Ji had to make a swift decision.

choices.description: Since Mr. Mo manifested at this moment, there must be profound meaning in it. Chen Ji decided to first listen to him clarify the key points, then plan his next move.
choices.risk_hint: Puppets may attack at any moment

dialogue.content: Mr. Mo's voice was urgent and solemn: "Boy, time is running out. The line of text on the Tianji Record is key—you are of Chen bloodline, you have the authority to seal the dragon vein. But sealing requires a price..." He paused, "You need to inject a portion of your Heavenly Fate into the puppets' bodies, forcibly breaking their connection to the dragon vein."

choices.description: Chen Ji had never liked relying on others; even Mr. Mo's words might not be entirely true. He decided to resolve the crisis before him based on his own judgment and the Tianji Record's abilities.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's power is profound and unfathomable

text.content: A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth as the Tianji Record Fragment spun wildly in his palm. He actively stepped into the formation's core, allowing that torrential power to wash over himself. This seemingly suicidal act caused the puppets' movements to hesitate for an instant—they sensed a threat.

dialogue.content: "Interesting little creature. Do you think this alone can break free from fate's shackles?" The voice carried a hint of amusement, "But do you truly wish to know the truth? Even if that truth would completely destroy the world you now inhabit?"

text.content: Just then, from the depths of the dragon vein came a thunderous rumble. The entire stone chamber began to shake violently, and the four puppets' movements abruptly paused, as if suppressed by some even more powerful force. Chen Ji took advantage of this gap to retreat rapidly, only to discover—at the formation's core beneath the altar, the golden light suddenly surged, and a虚幻的人影正slowly凝聚成形.

It was a young man's silhouette, his features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, yet his brow carried an extra degree of vicissitudes and dominance. Around him swirled golden runes, identical to the text on the Tianji Record. Chen Tianming—the true Chen Tianming, or rather, a wisp of his remnant consciousness preserved within the dragon vein.

dialogue.content: (Forcefully suppressing the churning emotions within) Are you... Chen Tianming? The true Chen Tianming?

text.content: The ethereal figureslightly颔首，声音如远古钟鸣般回荡在石室中："陈家后人，你终于来了。吾等这一天，已等了万年。"他的目光落在陈机怀中的残页上，眼中闪过一丝complex的情绪，"天机录……它终于回到了陈氏血脉手中。"
然而下一刻，那道身影abruptly转头看向四座傀儡，眼中立时涌起滔天murderous："天道之眼的走狗，竟然敢染指我陈家的龙脉！"话音未落，一道璀璨的剑光从虚幻的身影中激射而出，直取最近那座傀儡的头颅。剑光所过之处，连空气都被撕裂出一道漆黑的裂缝。
傀儡的反应同样惊人。它们眼眶中的血色火焰abruptly暴涨，周身的龙脉锁链化作四道黑色的闪电迎了上去。两股力量在半空中激烈碰撞，爆发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣。整个禁地都在这股冲击波下颤抖，仿佛随时都会崩塌。陈机被这股力量逼得连连后退，嘴角溢出一丝血迹——这是天机录在保护他，同时也在warning他：这里的战斗，已不是他能轻易介入的层次。

dialogue.content: (心中急速思索) 陈天命的残念……果然还活着。若能获得他的传承，天机录的完整之道或许就能……但这傀儡背后的天道之眼，绝不会善罢甘休。

text.content: 石室深处，陈天命的残念与四座傀儡的战斗愈发激烈。然而陈机敏锐地察觉到，那道残念的力量正在急速消耗——他不过是一缕残留的意识，无法维持太久。必须做出选择，而且要快！天机录残页上的符文突然剧烈跳动，浮现出两行金色的小字："龙脉之心，封印之法。"以及——"天命所归，舍身取义。"

choice.prompt: 陈天命的残念正在消散，傀儡的threatening尚未解除，而天机录给出的两条线索似乎指向不同的道路。陈机必须在千钧一发之际做出抉择。

choices.description: 天机录既然给出了封印之法，说明这是最稳妥的解决方案。陈机决定将天命注入龙脉之心，强行封印傀儡的能量来源。
choices.risk_hint: 可能永久失去部分天命

text.content: 陈机深吸一口气，双手结出天机录上的法印。他将体内的天命之力尽数抽出，化作一道璀璨的光柱注入祭台核心。金色的光芒瞬间笼罩整座石室，四座傀儡发出凄厉的嘶鸣，身上的龙脉锁链开始龟裂、崩解。

dialogue.content: "不！"那来自天道之眼的声音第一次带上了furious的情绪，"区区凡人，竟敢染指龙脉！你会为此付出代价的！"

choices.description: 与其被动封印，不如take initiative。陈机决定尝试请求陈天命的残念将毕生所学传承给他，哪怕只有一部分，也足以让他拥有与天道之眼对抗的资本。

text.content: 陈机abruptly抬头，直视陈天命的残念："前辈，我愿承继你的意志，补全天机录，揭露天道之眼的阴谋！"话音刚落，一股磅礴的信息流便如洪水般涌入他的脑海。那是陈天命毕生的感悟——天机录的完整结构、龙脉的秘密、甚至是如何逆转天命的禁忌之法。

dialogue.content: 墨先生的残魂在一旁excited地颤抖："这……这是天机录的核心心法！小子，你赚大了！但承受这份传承需要极强的神识支撑，若是失败……"

text.content: 就在陈机做出选择的瞬间，四座傀儡同时发出震天的嘶吼。它们似乎感知到了threatening，不再理会陈天命的残念，而是齐齐将矛头指向了陈机。黑色的闪电从它们眼中激射而出，携带着毁天灭地的威能。与此同时，陈天命的残念abruptly暴涨，化作一道金色的屏障挡在陈机身前。
"走！"陈天命的声音在陈机耳边炸响，"吾之残念无法支撑太久，带着天机录离开此地！你身上有吾陈家的血脉，也是天机录唯一的选择——"话音未落，那道金色屏障便与黑色闪电轰然相撞。惊天动地的爆炸声中，整座石室的穹顶开始崩塌，无数星辉石如流星般坠落。
陈机死死抓住天机录残页，任由那股磅礴的传承之力在体内肆虐。他能感受到陈天命的意志正在消散，但那股力量——那股足以撼动天地的力量——正在与他的神识融为一体。眼前的世界开始变得模糊，只剩下陈天命最后的话语回荡在脑海中："记住，天机录的真正秘密……不在于预知未来……而在于……"
声音戛然而止。陈机abruptly睁开双眼，发现自己已经身处禁地入口之外。身后的皇城禁地已是一片废墟，尘土漫天，仿佛刚刚经历了一场灭世之战。他低头看向怀中的天机录残页——上面的符文比之前更加璀璨，而且多出了一页原本不存在的内容：那是陈天命的传承，一段关于龙脉与天机录深层联系的完整记载。
然而陈机还未来得及细看，一股彻骨的寒意便从背后袭来。他abruptly回头，只见皇城上空凝聚着一只巨大的眼睛——那眼睛通体漆黑，瞳孔却是血红色的，正直直地注视着他。天道之眼，真正的天道之眼。它不再是某个傀儡的代言人，而是超越一切的存在，此刻正以本体注视着这个胆敢染指龙脉的凡人。
陈机的瞳孔suddenly收缩。这一刻，他终于明白了墨先生欲言又止的真正原因——天机录的秘密之所以被层层掩埋，不是因为它太过强大，而是因为它的存在本身，就在挑战天道之眼的权威。预知未来？改变命运？天道之眼绝不允许任何存在染指它的权柄。而现在，他已经成为了天道之眼的眼中钉。
就在这千钧一发之际，天机录残页abruptly爆发出一道璀璨的光芒，将天道之眼的注视暂时隔绝在外。墨先生的声音在陈机脑海中响起，带着前所未有的grave："小子，快走！这道屏障撑不了多久！天道之眼已经锁定你了，从现在起，无论你走到哪里，都会被它注视！"陈机咬紧牙关，转身化作一道流光消失在夜色之中。身后，那只巨大的眼睛slowly闭合，但它在陈机心中种下的fearful，却如同种子般开始生根……
